about.intro: My academic journey in Computer Science began in Matric with C, advanced through Intermediate with C++, and expanded independently into Python. I specialize in breaking down complex real-world problems into elegant, object-oriented solutions and scalable architectures.

education.institution: German University of Technology in Oman (GUTech)
education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (BSCS)
education.description: Pursuing rigorous computer science education affiliated with RWTH Aachen University standards. Focus on advanced computational theory, systems engineering, software design, and solution architecture.
Comprehensive pre-university curriculum focusing on analytical sciences, programming languages, and relational databases.
Solid foundational background in mathematics, core computer science concepts, and introductory procedural programming in C.

projects.title: RAPTOR Algorithm Flowcharts
projects.summary: Visual algorithm design suite built with RAPTOR, creating executable flowchart architectures to validate complex mathematical logic, looping invariants, and conditional branching.
highlights: Engineered modular flowcharts mapping procedural solutions into visual state diagrams.
Demonstrated edge-case handling, recursion models, and optimized decision trees.
Served as a foundational bridge between human-readable pseudocode and compiled C/C++ execution.

projects.title: Battery-Free Solar-Powered Flashlight
projects.summary: Sustainable hardware engineering concept that replaces degrading chemical battery packs with high-efficiency photovoltaic cells and supercapacitors for virtually infinite charge-discharge cycles.
highlights: Designed rapid-charge energy storage using ultra-capacitors, eliminating lithium waste and toxic degradation.
Integrated high-lumen low-draw LED array with passive voltage step-up regulation.
Created an emergency and disaster-resilient lighting design requiring zero maintenance or cell replacements.
